in_marathi.name: Avakasa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avakasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avakasa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ava' meaning 'up' or 'towards the sky' and 'kasa' meaning 'container' or 'vessel'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, the deity of the sky and rain. Avakasa is believed to signify power, strength, and protection against adversity.
